events.description: A large nighttime crowd is gathered in a public space, with individuals holding flags and banners, some wearing helmets or protective gear, and moving in an agitated manner; the scene culminates in a wide shot showing a building (possibly governmental) surrounded by protesters with red banners and signs, consistent with a violent unrest or riot.

A large crowd of demonstrators, many holding Greek and other flags, confronts a line of riot police in front of a neoclassical government building at night. The crowd is densely packed and actively pushing against police barriers and shields.

Direct physical engagement between protesters and riot police: individuals are seen grabbing and pushing against police shields and barriers; one protester in dark clothing lunges forward to strike or shove a shielded officer (visible in f12–f15).

A large group of people is gathered on a street at night, holding red and blue/white flags, moving aggressively toward or around vehicles; smoke or haze is present, and police presence (marked vehicle) is visible nearby, indicating collective violent unrest.

In frames f13–f15, blurred figures appear in close proximity with dynamic motion suggesting physical struggle; one figure in yellow helmet appears to be engaged with others amid smoke and crowd, though details are obscured.
A visible muzzle flash and projectile trace (purple streak) emanate from the crowd as seen through a targeting reticle, indicating active gunfire.
A dense, agitated crowd at night with raised arms, flags, and chaotic movement; combined with subsequent confirmed shooting, this constitutes collective violent unrest.

A violent clash between a crowd of protesters (some holding flags, including Greek national flags) and a line of riot police in helmets and shields behind metal barricades. The crowd is actively pushing against the barricades, attempting to breach the police line; smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) is present and intensifies over time, obscuring visibility. Physical contact and forceful pressure are evident across multiple frames.

Direct physical combat occurs between individuals in the front line: one person in dark clothing is seen swinging a long object (possibly a pole or banner staff) toward police or other individuals near the barricade (f0–f1), and in f4, a person appears to be struck or falling backward amid close-quarters struggle.

Sustained violent clash between a crowd of protesters (some holding Greek flags) and riot police in full gear, involving physical pushing, use of barriers, and heavy smoke/tear gas deployment. The scene shows dynamic confrontation with officers advancing and protesters resisting or retreating under dense haze.

Direct physical engagement between individuals: in f1 and f2, a person in dark clothing is seen grappling with another individual near metal barricades, with visible arm contact and body tension consistent with mutual combat.

Blurred but discernible close-quarters struggle in smoke-filled environment; frames f7–f9 show figures locked together, one raising an arm in a striking motion while others press in—suggestive of ongoing hand-to-hand fighting amid the riot.

Nighttime street scene with dense crowd, smoke or tear gas visible, and a person holding a red-and-white flag (resembling Indonesian flag) amid chaotic motion; consistent with collective violent unrest.
